title: OpenPaymentMandate
description: An open Payment Mandate: signed by the user, carrying the limits within which an agent may later authorise a payment, and bound to that agent's key. It may also fix parts of the payment outright — a user who says 'pay this merchant, from this card, up to 50 EUR' has pinned the payee and instrument and constrained only the amount. A pinned field is not a constraint the verifier evaluates; it is a value the closed mandate must reproduce unchanged.
$comment: agent_key is the public key of the agent this mandate authorises; AP2 carries it as the RFC 7800 'cnf' claim. payee, payment_amount, payment_instrument and execution_date are pinned values rather than constraints: present means the user fixed that field and the closed mandate must reproduce it unchanged. A user who wants a ceiling rather than an exact figure states a constraint instead of pinning the amount.

constraints.description: The limits the user approved. Evaluated by the verifier against the closed Payment Mandate the agent presents.

execution_date.description: Execution date pinned at authorisation time, ISO 8601 calendar date.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which this mandate was issued.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp after which this mandate must not be accepted. Should be the smallest value that lets the agent finish the task it was given.
